faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: How do I set up my product to work on a TCP/IP network?
faqs.answer:
If you have an existing network, TCP/IP is probably being used and being distributed by a DHCP device (a DHCP server or DHCP stand-alone router/gateway, for example). All you need to do is verify that a TCP/IP address has been obtained or manually enable TCP/IP through the CX11N's control panel.
Follow these steps to verify whether a TCP/IP address has been obtained:
Press the
Setup
button.
At the
Printer Settings
option, press the
button.
At the
Information
option, press the
button.
Use the
button to select
Network Status Sheet
, then press the
button. The CX11N will print a status sheet.
On the status sheet, check the second item in the
TCP/IP
section and verify that the IP address has a number such as the example shown below:
IP Address
135.792.46.813
Subnet Mask
255.255.255.0
Default Gateway
135.792.46.001
The information in the
TCP/IP
section on your status sheet should match the network segment being used on the network that the computers belong to.
If the IP address in the
TCP/IP
section is 169.254.43.71 and the information is as shown below, the network is not releasing a TCP/IP address to the CX11N.
IP Address
169.254.43.71
Subnet Mask
255.255.0.0
Default Gateway
(None)
Follow these steps to enable the CX11N to accept a TCP/IP address:
Press the
Setup
button.
Use the
button to select
Host I/F Settings
, then press the
button.
Use the
button to select
Network Settings
, then press the
button.
Use the
button to select
Network I/F=On
, then press the
button.
Turn the CX11N off, wait 1 minute, then turn it back on.
Reprint a network status sheet to verify that the CX11N has obtained a TCP/IP address. The CX11N should now be enabled for TCP/IP and available on the network segment.
Install the CX11N software in network mode to print and scan from the network.

faqs.question: The Print light does not turn on when I turn on the product. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the power cord is plugged into both a power outlet and the CX11N. Also, make sure the outlet is operational and not connected to a timer or switch.

faqs.question: How do I print a status sheet?
faqs.answer:
See
Printing a Status Sheet
.

faqs.question: When I press the B&W Start or Color Start button to make a copy, nothing happens. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
The CX11N may not be in Copy mode when you are pressing the button (Print mode is the default mode). Make sure you press the
Copy
button before you press either
B&W Start
or
Color Start
.
Note:
If you don't press any button for more than 3 minutes, the CX11N returns to Print mode.
Make sure paper is loaded in the MP tray or the optional Paper Cassette Unit. See
Loading Paper
.
Make sure your original is placed face-down on the document table. See
Setting Your Originals
.

faqs.question: What sizes of documents can I copy or scan with my product?
faqs.answer: You can copy or scan any document up to size A4 (8.5” x 11.7”).

faqs.question: It takes a long time to copy a document. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select
B&W
as the copy type.
Select
With Border
as the layout type.*
Make sure
2-Sided Printing
is turned off.*
Select
Plain Paper
as the paper type.
Select
Draft
or
Standard
as the quality type.
Make sure
Dry Time
is set to
Standard
.*
* This step may not apply to your all-in-one.

faqs.question: When I try to copy using the High quality document type setting at the same time as the 2 Pages per Sheet setting, I get a memory error message. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
To use the
High quality
setting, your CX11N should have at least 256MB of memory. If you're not sure how much memory your CX11N has,
print a status sheet
and then
add memory
if necessary.

faqs.question: Why do I see the message Mem Overflow on my product's LCD screen?
faqs.answer:
The CX11N doesn't have enough memory to print the job. Press the
B&W Start
or
Color Start
to resume printing, or press the
Cancel
button to cancel the print job.

faqs.question: Why do I see the message Check Transparency on my product's LCD screen?
faqs.answer:
There may be a mismatch between the loaded paper or transparencies and the printer driver setting for your paper or transparencies.
Also, paper may be jammed in the MP (multi-purpose) tray.
Clear jammed paper
if necessary.

faqs.question: How often should I clean my product?
faqs.answer:
The product needs only minimal cleaning. When print quality has decreased, scan quality has decreased, or there is trouble with paper feeding, cleaning the CX11N may solve the problem. See
Cleaning the Product
.

faqs.question: How can I upgrade the memory on my product?
faqs.answer:
See
Memory Module
.

faqs.question: How do I create a custom paper size in the Server Properties?
faqs.answer:
Follow these steps to create a new page size accessible by all printer drivers installed in Windows:
Open the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window.
Click
File
, then
Server Properties
.
Put a check in the
Create a new form
box.
Input a name for the custom paper size.
Under
Paper Size
, enter the desired height and width.
Click
Save
or
Save Form
to add the new form size to the list, then
OK
to close Server Properties.

faqs.question: How do I create a custom paper size for my product in Windows?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Open the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window.
Right click you Epson Printer and select
Printing Preferences
.
On the Main or Paper tab, select
User Defined
from the Paper Size drop down menu.
Enter the custom paper size and name.
Click
Save
then
OK
.
Click
OK
.
How do I create a custom paper size within my Epson Windows printer driver?

faqs.question: How do I clear a paper jam?
faqs.answer:
See
Clearing Jammed Paper
.

faqs.question: What types and quantities of paper can I load in my product?
faqs.answer:
You can load paper in the MP (multi-purpose) tray or the optional Paper Cassette Unit. For information on the types and quantities of paper you can use in each, see
Paper Sources
.
You can purchase the optional Paper Cassette Unit (part # C12C802181) from the Epson Store or from a local Epson dealer.

faqs.question: Some or all of my printout is garbled. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure both ends of the interface cable are fully plugged in. The interface cable may not be securely connected.
Make sure you're using an interface cable with the correct specifications. If you're using a USB cable, make sure it is a shielded “AB” cable no more than 6.5 feet (2 meters) long.
Make sure you have the correct printer driver selected in your software.

Copies are blank, or images are missing or faded

faqs.question: The quality of my copies is not good. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure you're using the correct type of paper for copying. The available paper types for copying are not the same as those for printing. Depending on the paper source, the following paper types are available for copying:
MP Tray: Plain paper, Letterhead, Recycled paper, Colored paper, Transparencies, Labels
Optional Paper Cassette Unit: Plain paper, Letterhead, Recycled paper, Colored paper
For more help with copy quality, see
Copy Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: My scanned image is blurry. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
The image is distorted or blurred
.

faqs.question: Why are the colors of my scanned image wrong?
faqs.answer:
See
Colors differ from the original
.

faqs.question: My scans are being cropped (the edges are missing). What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure you place your original at least .06 inches (1.5 mm) away from the top and left edges of the document table (glass) to avoid image cropping.

faqs.question: My product is new and all the colors are printing incorrectly. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure the toner cartridges are installed in the correct slots. The back plate of each cartridge slot is color coded to match the toner color for that slot.
Yellow toner cartridge
Yellow toner slot

faqs.question: Why doesn't scanning start when I press the B&W Start or Color Start button?

.

The scanner software does not work properly

faqs.question: How do I decide which resolution to select when scanning from Epson Scan?
faqs.answer:
See
Selecting the Scan Resolution

faqs.question: I want to enlarge an image that I'm scanning with Epson Scan. How do I obtain the best quality?
faqs.answer:
To obtain the best quality, you should resize your image when you're scanning instead of enlarging it later in an image-editing program.
For specific instructions on resizing your image when you're scanning, see
Selecting the Scan Size
.
Note:
If you plan to enlarge your image later in an image-editing program, you need to increase the
Resolution
setting to retain a high image quality after enlargement. Increase the resolution by the same amount you will increase the image size. For example, if the resolution is 300 dpi (dots per inch), but you will increase the image size by 200% in an image-editing program, change the
Resolution
setting to 600 dpi in Epson Scan.

faqs.question: The settings are grayed out in Epson Scan on my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Create a new user account using the instructions below.  If you are able to change the settings in Epson Scan using the new account but not with the old account, please contact Apple for possible solutions.
Click the Apple icon, then select
System Preferences
.
Under
System
, select
Accounts
.
If the padlock in the lower left corner is locked, click it to unlock it and enter the password when prompted.
Click the
+
to create a new account.
At the top, change the New Account field to
Administrator
.
Complete the required fields, then click
Create Account
.  (Do not set to automatically log in).
Close the Accounts screen, click on the Apple icon to log out, then log in as the new user.
Open Epson Scan.

Start
or
.

Windows XP
:

Printers and Faxes

Settings

Printers and Faxes

Windows Vista
:

Control Panel

or

under Hardware and Sound

:

Control Panel

In the
Printers
or

Properties

OK
.
Click
OK
again.

faqs.question: The Print light does not turn on when I turn on the product. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the power cord is plugged into both a power outlet and the CX11N. Also, make sure the outlet is operational and not connected to a timer or switch.

faqs.question: The Print light is on but nothing prints. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If your CX11N won't print, you may have one of the following problems:
Your computer may not be securely connected to the CX11N. Check the connection at both ends. If you're using a USB cable, connect the square end of the cable to the back of the CX11N and the flat end of the USB cable to any open USB port on your computer.
Your application software may not be set up correctly. Make sure the CX11N is selected in your software.
Your computer system's memory may be too small to handle the volume of data in your document. Try reducing the image resolution in your application software, or install more memory in your computer.

faqs.question: My product is connected to my computer with a USB cable and scanning is too slow. How can I improve my scanning speed?
faqs.answer:
If your computer supports USB 2.0, make sure the USB port on the CX11N is set for high speed.  Follow these steps to adjust the USB speed setting:
Make sure the CX11N is turned on, then press the
Setup
button. The
Setup
light comes on and the LCD screen displays
Setup Mode
for a few seconds, then changes to the
Setup
menu screen.
Use the
or
button to select
Host I/F Settings
, then press the
button.
Use the
or
button to select
USB Settings
, then press the
button.
Use the
or
button to select
USB Speed
, then press the
button.
Use the
or
button to select
HS
.
Press the
Scan
button to exit Setup mode and return to Scan mode.
Turn the CX11N off and then back on to activate the setting.

faqs.question: Why won't my product scan?
faqs.answer:
See
The product does not scan
.

faqs.question: My product is connected to my computer with a USB cable, but the computer won't recognize it. Why?
faqs.answer:
Your CX11N may not work properly if you use a USB cable other than the one supplied by Epson. Use the USB cable that comes with your product.
Also, the CX11N may not work properly if you connect it to the computer through more than one hub. Connect the CX11N directly to your computer's USB port, or through one hub only.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.
